column7: 2026-11-06: On release/10.x, any code fix landing here must bump the patch version in package.json in the same change. Reason: CI publishes 10.x straight from release/10.x whenever the package.json version changes, so a fix without a bump never ships. (Stated by the user.)
2026-11-06: Do not edit the version in package.json on branch next (user's rule). Reason: the release job derives the version from the changesets and fails if anyone bumps it by hand.
